errors.asset_expired: This download link has expired and the file was removed.
errors.asset_not_ready: The file is still being prepared and isn't ready to download.
errors.asset_not_ready.next: Wait a moment and try again.
errors.bad_request: This request wasn't valid, so nothing was processed.
errors.bad_request.next: Refresh the page and try again.
errors.bootstrap_invalid: This one-time sign-in link is invalid or has already been used.
errors.bootstrap_invalid.next: Run the sign-in command on this computer again to get a new link.
errors.capability_unavailable: A component this feature needs isn't available, so nothing was done.
errors.capability_unavailable.next: Install or configure what the technical details mention, then try again.
errors.client_wait_timeout: Not done yet — check back later.
errors.client_wait_timeout.next: It's still being processed in the background; no need to submit it again.
errors.control_secret_invalid: The control secret is missing or wrong, so the request was refused.
errors.control_secret_invalid.next: Check the control secret printed when the service started, then try again.
errors.coordinator_timeout: Waiting for KLayout timed out, so it's unclear whether this finished.
errors.coordinator_timeout.next: Check this task's status again later instead of submitting it again.
errors.cursor_scope_mismatch: The list has moved on, so this page of results no longer applies.
errors.cursor_scope_mismatch.next: Reload the list from the beginning.
errors.default_project_exists: A project that already records everything on this machine exists, so another one can't be added.
errors.default_project_exists.next: Reuse that project instead of creating a new one.
errors.document_read_only: This layout is read-only and can't be recorded or written to.
errors.document_read_only.next: Switch to a writable layout if you need recording.
errors.export_failed: Saving this version failed, so the file wasn't created.
errors.export_failed.next: Try again; if it keeps failing, check the technical details.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this, so nothing was done.
errors.forbidden.next: Check that you're signed in to the right project.
errors.generic.next: Try again in a moment; if this keeps happening, check the technical details.
errors.history_root_inside_git: This folder is inside a Git checkout and could get synced or committed, so nothing was done.
errors.history_root_inside_git.next: Choose a folder outside any Git checkout.
errors.history_root_not_empty: This folder already has other files in it, so nothing was done, to avoid overwriting them.
errors.history_root_not_empty.next: Choose an empty folder, or one that's already a Vestigraph history folder.
errors.history_unreadable: The history folder can't be read — it may be locked or damaged.
errors.history_unreadable.next: Check that the folder is accessible, then try again.
errors.host_not_allowed: This address isn't trusted, so the request was refused.
errors.host_not_allowed.next: Use the local address the service printed.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This request was already submitted once with different content, so it wasn't repeated.
errors.idempotency_conflict.next: Refresh the page, then try the action again.
errors.internal_error: The service hit an internal problem, so this may not have completed.
errors.internal_error.next: Try again; if this keeps happening, check the technical details and contact the maintainer.
errors.job_lost: This task is no longer tracked by the service (it may have restarted), so its result can't be shown.
errors.network.next: Check that the service is still running, then try again.
errors.not_found: This couldn't be found — it may have been removed or never existed.
errors.not_found.next: Go back to the list and choose again.
errors.not_recording_document: This layout isn't currently being recorded, so nothing was done.
errors.not_recording_document.next: Make sure automatic recording has started, then try again.
errors.open_failed: Opening this version in KLayout failed. The saved version itself is unaffected.
errors.open_failed.next: Try again; if it keeps failing, check the technical details.
errors.open_unconfirmed: The editor did not confirm the result. The version may already be open.
errors.open_unconfirmed.next: Check the editor before trying again; do not repeat blindly.
errors.open_unsupported: This editor cannot open this file format.
errors.open_unsupported.next: Choose an editor that supports this format, or download the file.
errors.path_not_directory: This path already exists but isn't a folder, so nothing was done.
errors.payload_too_large: This submission was too large and wasn't accepted.
errors.payload_too_large.next: Shorten the content and try again.
errors.policy_version_conflict: This project's settings changed elsewhere, so what you saw wasn't the latest version.
errors.policy_version_conflict.next: Refresh the page to get the latest settings, then try again.
errors.preview_parse_failed: Preview couldn't read this version's saved file.
errors.preview_parse_failed.next: Try again; if it keeps failing, download it or open it in KLayout to check it directly.
errors.preview_timeout: Generating this preview took too long and was stopped. The saved file itself wasn't affected.
errors.preview_timeout.next: Try again in a moment, or download this version instead.
errors.preview_too_large: This version is too large to preview here, but it's still saved safely.
errors.preview_too_large.next: Download it, or open it in KLayout instead.
errors.preview_unavailable: Preview isn't available for this version right now. The saved file is unaffected.
errors.preview_unavailable.next: Download it, or open it in KLayout instead.
errors.preview_unsupported_format: This version's file format isn't supported for preview, but the saved file itself is fine.
errors.preview_unsupported_format.next: Download it, or open it in KLayout instead.
errors.preview_worker_failed: The preview process hit an internal problem, so this preview couldn't be made. The saved file is safe.
errors.preview_worker_failed.next: Try again; if it keeps failing, check the technical details.
errors.queue_full: The task queue is full, so this request wasn't accepted.
errors.queue_full.next: Wait a moment and try again.
errors.recorder_error: Automatic recording hit a problem, so this action may not have completed.
errors.recorder_error.next: Check the recording status; if this keeps happening, check the technical details.
errors.relocate_bad_destination: This destination overlaps a folder the service or workspace already uses, so nothing was moved.
errors.relocate_bad_destination.next: Choose a folder that doesn't contain, or sit inside, that folder.
errors.relocate_conflict: The destination already has a folder with this name, so the move was stopped; the original folder is untouched.
errors.relocate_conflict.next: Choose an empty folder and try again.
errors.relocate_same_folder: This is already the current history folder, so nothing was moved.
errors.relocate_verify_failed: The copied files don't match the originals, so the move was stopped; nothing was switched, and the old folder is untouched.
errors.relocate_verify_failed.next: Check the destination disk's space and permissions, then try again.
errors.session_changed: That KLayout window has changed since you chose it (for example, it was restarted), so this wasn't sent.
errors.session_changed.next: Choose the window again, then try.
errors.session_not_found: The chosen KLayout window is no longer available, so nothing was opened.
errors.session_not_found.next: Choose another online KLayout window and try again.
errors.session_offline: That KLayout window is no longer online.
errors.session_offline.next: Choose an online window from the list.
errors.tail_not_saved: The latest changes could not be saved, so the history version was not opened.
errors.tail_not_saved.next: Check KLayout and the recording status, then try again.
errors.top_cell_not_found: The top cell named for this layout doesn't exist, so this couldn't proceed.
errors.top_cell_not_found.next: Check the layout's top cell in KLayout, then try again.
errors.top_cell_required: This layout doesn't have a top cell set, so this couldn't proceed.
errors.top_cell_required.next: Set a top cell in KLayout, then try again.
errors.unauthenticated.next: Sign in again, then try again.
errors.unknown_job_kind: The service doesn't recognize this kind of task, so it wasn't processed.
errors.unknown_job_kind.next: Refresh the page and try again.
